text:
Maya R.: Heads up — customer acct_9f3b (ACME) flagged an invoice mismatch during month-end. Invoice INV-2026-0315-ACME shows an enterprise tier charge for 3/31 but our dashboard export for the same period reports Standard tier + no proration line. Customer is upset. Can someone triage quickly?

Olivia - support: Thanks Maya. Can you paste the account id + the billing export CSV link and any invoice PDF? I'll open a CS ticket.

Maya R.: acct_9f3b here: https://internal-exports.s3.redwood/acct_9f3b/2026-03/dashboard-export.csv and invoice PDF https://billing.redwood/invoices/INV-2026-0315-ACME.pdf — created ticket CS-4879. No customer-initiated plan change in support notes.

Liam (finance): Looking. Quick Q — did they submit a contract or legal change that could have triggered a plan reclass?

Maya R.: Not that I can see; sales notes for March show trial->standard upgrade on 2026-02-04 only.

Raj (eng-metrics): I ran a cursory audit against metering and subscription events. Short summary: token totals match between metering and dashboard (1,234,567 tokens for the billing window), but subscription_events shows a plan_id flip at 2026-03-31T00:00:05Z. Looks like an automated migration job touched the subscription just after midnight. Posting snippet: 

```
subscription_events
-------------------
acct_id: acct_9f3b
event_time: 2026-03-31T00:00:05Z
prev_plan: standard-v2
new_plan: enterprise-v2
trigger: migration-job-#452
metadata: {source: admin-mass-migrate, actor: service-account-billing}
```

Olivia - support: @billing-bot any orchestration events around that time?

billing-bot: :gear: migration-job-#452 completed for 312 accounts at 2026-03-31T00:00:05Z. Run triggered by admin-scheduled-window. Job link: https://ops.redwood/jobs/452

Nadia (acct-rep): I don't have any signed amendment for ACME. They explicitly told their AE they didn't want enterprise. We need to revert and offer a credit if the invoice already collected.

Liam (finance): If the subscription flip happened before invoice generation then billing service would have applied enterprise pricing to the final day and invoice calc would pick that up. We need to know: was invoice calc run before or after the job?

Raj (eng-metrics): Invoice generation timestamp from billing logs: 2026-03-31T00:05:30Z. So invoice was created ~5m after the migration job. That explains enterprise charge showing up.

Maya R.: Ugh. So automated job migrated them without consent and invoice ran right after. CS ticket already has the customer's message. Recommended next steps?

Olivia - support: Proposed immediate steps: 1) run a billing re-calc and regenerate invoice with prev_plan effective for whole period; 2) if payment already captured, issue a credit for the delta; 3) block migration-job-#452 and audit affected accounts list.

Raj (eng-metrics): For repro/audit I recommend these commands (internal admin):

```
# get subscription events for acct
SELECT * FROM subscription_events WHERE acct_id='acct_9f3b' ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 10;

# re-run invoice calc (dry-run)
curl -X POST "https://billing-internal.redwood/admin/recalc" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"account_id":"acct_9f3b","invoice_date":"2026-03-31","dry_run":true}'
```

Raj (eng-metrics): Dry-run output shows corrected invoice lines (standard tier + proration line -$0.00) and total lower by $2,400. I can run non-dry if finance confirms.

Liam (finance): Approve non-dry run and issue credit if payment status is paid. Also please capture full list from job #452 so we can proactively reconcile.

Nadia (acct-rep): I'll draft the customer note offering apology + immediate credit and updated invoice. Will loop legal if needed.

Maya R.: I'll pause any further invoice notifications for ACME until we regenerate. Also adding incident tag: billing-incident-2026-03-31 / ops-priority.

Olivia - support: Filing follow-ups: CS-4879 -> assigned to Olivia, FIN-2102 for credit workflow assigned to Liam, ENG-9031 to block and roll back job #452 assigned to Raj.

Raj (eng-metrics): After rollback I'll run a small script to compare invoice lines for all accounts touched by #452 and output a CSV. Command: `/ops/job-452-audit --output s3://internal-exports/job-452-audit.csv`

billing-bot: :white_check_mark: job-452-audit started. Will notify when CSV is ready.

Liam (finance): Thanks team. Once CSV lands, finance will sample 100 invoices and issue credits where appropriate. Keep CS on a tight loop for any customers who already paid.

Maya R.: Thanks — ping me if you need more from support or to forward customer emails.

Olivia - support: Will update CS-4879 with next actions and ETA for updated invoice (aiming 4 hours). :hourglass_flowing_sand:
